description: This file contains a database migration class for the Android app, handling schema changes from version 14 to 15, including table renaming, creation, and data migration for notes and categories.

classes.name: Migration_14_15
classes.description: A migration class extending Room's Migration to handle database schema updates between versions 14 and 15, including data transformation and table creation.

methods.name: Migration_14_15
methods.description: Constructor setting the migration path from schema version 14 to 15.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Executes the schema migration: renaming the old notes table, creating the new schema, migrating data, and cleaning up.

methods.name: createIndex
methods.description: Utility method to create database indexes on specified columns.
